text:
Two hours ago I said dates were compulsory from now on. Both of you turned up with one without being asked. That's the fastest a thread has ever fixed me.

Bimodal_user, that closes the row. Podcast streaming, Classic only, processor not worn, twenty five metres through a load bearing wall, April 2025, before the Ultra firmware. I can finally write it down, and I'm writing the firmware caveat down with it because you offered it and I wouldn't have known to ask.

Neville, yours is the second Classic point and it points the same way. Moxi V on a Galaxy S22, Android 16, solid in and out regardless of pocket.

So the Classic row now reads two steady against one glitchy, and the glitchy one is d_Wooluf's from late 2024 with no idea what was playing. Oldest and thinnest. I'm not throwing it out, but I know where it sits now.

Your S20 memory I'm taking as a memory, not a datum, because you said yourself the aids may have changed too. Same for which side. You wrote I'd have to test again, so that's what goes in the notes.

The Signia and Widex line is the part I'd underline though. Frequent enough outdoors that you stopped using them. That's the second person in two days who told me they gave up rather than that they complained, and giving up doesn't show in anybody's return figures.

Roger On dropping when it's properly body blocked is relevant, by the way. It's a body between a transmitter and an ear, which is the whole argument. It just isn't in a pocket.
reader_text:
[Neville #31] For what it's worth, Unitron Moxi V and Galaxy s22 is solid indoors and out regardless of pocket (classic bluetooth), Android 16. I recall it being more subject to opposite-side drop-outs with my galaxy s20, but that may also have been an earlier model of either the Moxi or the Audeo. Signia and Widex drop-outs outside are frequent to the point that I find them too annoying to use, but with the s22 that's still going to be ASHA. I'd have to test them out again so see which side is the problem, but I'd thought it was opposite side. Roger On drops out if it is sufficiently body-blocked, probably not relevant to you.

[Bimodal_user #32] That was one of very few situations when I deliberately tested range of podcast streaming using Bluetooth Classic only to my Phonak Audeo Infinio Sphere 90. I didn't wear sound processor then. That was in April 2025 before Ultra firmware upgrade. Ultra firmware upgrade may change/improve that a bit.

Neville adds a second Classic point in the same direction (Unitron Moxi V, Galaxy S22, Android 16, steady in and out regardless of pocket) plus a second case of abandonment rather than complaint (Signia and Widex dropping outdoors often enough that he stopped using them). Reply records both, states the Classic row now reads two steady against one glitchy with the glitchy one being the oldest and thinnest, and explicitly declines to upgrade Neville's own hedges — his S20 recollection and his side memory stay notes rather than data because he said himself he would have to retest. Also picks up his Roger On aside, which he dismissed as irrelevant but is in fact a body between a transmitter and an ear, the argument itself minus the pocket. Combined rather than split to hold down our own comment density in a thread we opened.
